documents.title: Ganges View Heritage Hotel — Property Overview
documents.text: Ganges View Heritage Hotel is a 4-star boutique property on Assi Ghat, Varanasi. The hotel blends colonial architecture with modern comfort, targeting cultural travellers and pilgrims. Brand positioning emphasizes riverside serenity, curated heritage walks, and locally sourced cuisine. Star rating: 4. Ambiance: tranquil, spiritual, refined.

documents.title: Sacred Lotus Boutique Inn — Overview
documents.text: Sacred Lotus Boutique Inn is a 3-star design-led inn near Godowlia Chowk. Compact rooms, artisan decor, and a rooftop cafe define the experience. Positioned for budget-conscious explorers seeking authentic neighbourhood stays.

documents.title: Kashi Riverside Resort — Overview
documents.text: Kashi Riverside Resort is a 5-star resort on the Ganges with private ghats and spa villas. Premium leisure positioning for honeymoons and wellness retreats. Star rating: 5.

documents.title: The Marina Grand — Beach Resort Overview
documents.text: The Marina Grand is a 4-star beachfront resort in Goa, 50 metres from Calangute Beach. Family-friendly positioning with kids club and sea-view balconies. Ambiance: coastal, vibrant.

documents.title: Sunset Bay Beach Hotel — Overview
documents.text: Sunset Bay Beach Hotel is a 3-star property in South Goa with direct beach access. Known for sunset views and relaxed backpacker-luxe atmosphere.

documents.title: Royal Varuna Palace — Overview
documents.text: Royal Varuna Palace is a 5-star palace hotel near Varanasi Cantonment. Heritage luxury brand with banquet halls and royal suites for destination weddings.

documents.title: City Centre Metro Hotel — Overview
documents.text: City Centre Metro Hotel is a 3-star business hotel linked to Varanasi City metro station. Efficient, modern, aimed at corporate travellers and conference delegates.

documents.title: Himalayan Retreat Lodge — Overview
documents.text: Himalayan Retreat Lodge is a 4-star eco-lodge in Rishikesh with mountain views. Adventure and yoga positioning for nature-focused guests.

documents.title: Hotel X Residency — Overview
documents.text: Hotel X Residency is a 4-star business hotel in central Varanasi near the railway station. Known for reliable service, meeting rooms, and express check-in for corporate guests.

documents.title: Ganges View — Amenities
documents.text: Amenities include complimentary high-speed WiFi in all rooms and public areas. Guests receive a complimentary buffet breakfast daily from 6:30 to 10:00 AM in the ghat-view dining room. Additional facilities: riverside yoga deck, Ayurvedic spa, 24-hour concierge, in-room tea station, and laundry service. Parking is available on request.

documents.title: Sacred Lotus — Amenities
documents.text: Free WiFi throughout the property. Breakfast is available at the rooftop cafe for an additional charge (not complimentary). No spa; small fitness corner.

documents.title: Kashi Riverside — Amenities
documents.text: Complimentary WiFi, complimentary breakfast buffet, infinity pool, full-service spa, gym, private ghat access, and fine-dining restaurant.

documents.title: Marina Grand — Amenities
documents.text: Free WiFi, complimentary breakfast for all room categories, beach cabanas, outdoor pool, kids club, and seafood grill.

documents.title: City Centre Metro — Amenities
documents.text: Complimentary WiFi in lobby only; in-room WiFi is paid. Continental breakfast included with executive rooms only. Business centre and gym on site.

documents.title: Sunset Bay — Amenities
documents.text: Free WiFi in rooms and beach area. Complimentary light breakfast (fruit, bread, tea). Beach loungers and water sports desk.

documents.title: Hotel X — Amenities
documents.text: High-speed WiFi complimentary in all rooms. Buffet breakfast included with standard booking. Fitness centre, laundry, and airport shuttle (paid).

documents.title: Review — Ganges View (Positive)
documents.text: Rating: 4.5/5. 'Stunning ghat views and attentive staff. Breakfast spread was excellent. WiFi worked well for remote work.' — Priya M., March 2025.

documents.title: Review — Sacred Lotus (Neutral)
documents.text: Rating: 3.5/5. 'Charming rooms but breakfast is overpriced. WiFi dropped in the evening.' — James L., January 2025.

documents.title: Review — Marina Grand (Excellent)
documents.text: Rating: 4.9/5. 'Excellent beach location steps from the sand. Kids loved the pool. Outstanding reviews for cleanliness and breakfast. Best beach hotel we have stayed in.' — Anita & Rahul K., February 2025.

documents.title: Review — Sunset Bay (Positive)
documents.text: Rating: 4.2/5. 'Great value near the beach. Simple breakfast but fresh. Friendly staff.' — Marco T., December 2024.

documents.title: Review — Kashi Riverside (Positive)
documents.text: Rating: 4.7/5. 'Luxurious spa and flawless service. Worth the premium price.' — Elena S., April 2025.

documents.title: Review — City Centre (Negative)
documents.text: Rating: 2.8/5. 'Noisy rooms facing the metro. Paid WiFi frustrating. Breakfast only for executives.' — David P., November 2024.

documents.title: Review — Royal Varuna (Positive)
documents.text: Rating: 4.6/5. 'Palatial rooms and grand weddings venue. Food was exceptional.' — Meera J., October 2024.

documents.title: Review — Hotel X (Neutral)
documents.text: Rating: 3.9/5. 'Solid business hotel. Good WiFi and breakfast. Nothing exceptional but reliable.' — Sanjay R., March 2025.

documents.title: Review — Marina Grand (Negative detail)
documents.text: Rating: 3.8/5. 'Beach is crowded in peak season but hotel itself is excellent. Would still recommend for families.' — Chris W., January 2025.

documents.title: Review — Himalayan Retreat
documents.text: Rating: 4.4/5. 'Peaceful mountain stay. Yoga sessions at sunrise were highlight.' — Nina F., February 2025.

documents.title: Hotel X Residency — Cancellation Policy
documents.text: Cancellation policy for Hotel X Residency: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours incur one night charge. No-shows are charged 100% of the booking. Refunds processed within 7 business days to the original payment method.

documents.title: Ganges View — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM. Cancellation: free until 72 hours prior; 50% charge within 72 hours. Pets not allowed. Government photo ID required at check-in.

documents.title: Marina Grand — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 3:00 PM, check-out 12:00 PM. Flexible cancellation until 24 hours before arrival. Pet-friendly rooms available on request (surcharge applies). Passport or Aadhaar required.

documents.title: Kashi Riverside — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 2:00 PM. Non-refundable rate available at 15% discount. Standard rate: cancel 7 days prior for full refund. No pets.

documents.title: Sacred Lotus — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 1:00 PM, check-out 10:00 AM. Cancellation within 24 hours: first night charged. Small pets under 10 kg allowed with prior approval.

documents.title: City Centre Metro — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 12:00 PM. Corporate bookings: 24-hour cancellation window. Leisure bookings: 48-hour free cancellation. Valid ID mandatory.

documents.title: Sunset Bay — Policies
documents.text: Check-in 2:00 PM. Free cancellation up to 5 days before stay during monsoon season; otherwise 3 days prior. Refunds via UPI or card within 10 days.

documents.title: Marina Grand — Location
documents.text: Located at Calangute Beach, Goa — 50 metres from the main beach entrance. Nearby: Baga Beach (2 km), Saturday Night Market (1.5 km). Goa International Airport 40 km (approx. 75 min by taxi).

documents.title: Sunset Bay — Location
documents.text: South Goa, Palolem area — beachfront road, 100 m to Palolem Beach. Quiet neighbourhood, dolphin-watching boats nearby.

documents.title: Ganges View — Location
documents.text: Assi Ghat, Varanasi — 500 m from Assi Ghat steps, 4 km from Varanasi Junction railway station. Near: Banaras Hindu University (3 km), local boat jetty (200 m).

documents.title: Hotel X — Location
documents.text: Cantonment area, Varanasi — 1.2 km from Varanasi Junction, 45 min from Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport. Auto-rickshaw stand outside the hotel.

documents.title: Kashi Riverside — Location
documents.text: Riverside Road, Varanasi — private ghat access, 6 km from city centre. Temple circuit tours depart from the hotel jetty.

documents.title: City Centre Metro — Location
documents.text: Connected to Varanasi City Metro Station (Exit B). 2 km from Godowlia market, 15 min metro to Assi Ghat.

documents.title: Sacred Lotus — Location
documents.text: Godowlia Chowk, old city Varanasi — walking distance to Kashi Vishwanath corridor (15 min). Narrow lanes; hotel offers golf-cart pickup from main road.
